Capture date: 2026-11-13 UTC (2026-11-12 Pacific). Native capture of the surname fuzzy rules (plan Q2, panels A to I plus Lead mirrors of B and D).
Org: one fresh 30-day Developer Edition scratch org from a campaign Dev Hub, default Contact and Lead duplicate rules (Standard_Contact_Duplicate_Rule, Standard_Lead_Duplicate_Rule). The Dev Hub active scratch record went from 1 to 0 after deletion and the local target no longer resolves.
Frozen predictions: Glade campaign/v039-duplicate-test-reliability 7b860d462 with GLADE_STANDARD_DUPLICATE_RULES=on, run through glade exec at API 67.0 with the same Apex helper, before each native run. frozen/predicted-stage1.json (panels A, B, C, D, E, F, G; 42 methods), frozen/predicted-stage1b.json (panel B2, below), frozen/predicted-stage2.json (panels H and I, whose positives were chosen from native stage 1 positives, then predicted before the stage 2 org run). Hashes of the helper source, the pair lists and the predictions are listed below.
Panel B stage 1 used trailing vowels (all equal match key, native 100, Glade 100) and did not test the Rynk shape. Panel B2 replaces it: 12 fresh pairs with consonant trailing letters and equal Metaphone 3 codes (3 to 4 letters and 4 to 5 letters), Contact and Lead, both directions. B2 predictions were frozen before its run.
Design: one helper method per case, one Apex expression per case, typed AssertException, frame OBS|method|isTest|length|payload|ENDOBS. The deliberately raised assertion rolled back each transaction. Seeds carry exact first name Brannock and a per-pair email; Lead rows carry a distinct Company per pair. Each method holds only distinct stems, and each direction is its own method, so no pair can reach another pair's seed. Every method ends with an exact positive control and an unrelated negative control that are asserted inside Apex. Each entry records both Datacloud.FindDuplicates and Database.insert(row,false): label, int confidence and raw decimal string (label=int~raw), rule name (asserted), isAllowSave ('!' marks false), saved count. IDs are compared inside Apex; only labels are exported. Raw decimals were whole numbers in every observation.
APIs 62.0 and 67.0, routes anonymous and @IsTest, each combination run twice (repeat 1 and 2). Helper and test classes were redeployed at each API and ApexClass.ApiVersion was read back through Tooling API. The driver fails on Apex log truncation or exhaustion text, a missing or incomplete frame, a route mismatch, or a class API mismatch.
Result: all 8 observations (2 APIs x 2 routes x 2 repeats) of every one of the 62 methods are byte-identical. Find and DML agree on every entry. Lead rows equal Contact rows for B2 and D.
Inputs were generated from fresh stems: no stem is a prefix of any token in internal/apextest/testdata/conformance/duplicate_* or in earlier fuzzy-reliability pair lists.
Panels: A four-to-five trailing letter (4 stems at sums 16, 16, 42, 42 and 8 more at sums 12 to 54, eight trailing letters; the old stems Yent, Zela, Rume, Jlun as a directed non-holdout panel); B2 equal Metaphone 3 trailing letter; C three-to-four trailing letter (12 stems, 3 tails); D final-letter substitution (m/n at lengths 3 to 8, adjacent-key and far-key controls, Contact and Lead); E three-letter same-row adjacent swap at 14 sums; F five-letter terminal rotation at 12 sums plus 4 vertical and 4 wide controls; G eight-letter swap five columns apart, 2 stems at each sum 42 to 62; H corroboration controls (no email, different email, different first name, phone only) on 8 native positives, both directions; I upper case, accent, hyphen, second token on 4 positives, both directions.
